lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. The anterior clusters are smaller and more densely packed, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced centroids in the mid-flank region, roughly following a grid-like coordinate system.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a structured matrix of high-luminance nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, manifesting as a sharp horizontal boundary with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side and a pronounced shadow gradient on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of small-diameter high-luminance spots along its proximal leading edge, contrasting with the larger spot diameters found on the primary lateral flank.
